title: Operador de Produção de Painéis I (PCD)
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Essa oportunidade é destinada para pessoas com deficiência.


Principais atividades:

  • Executar as atividades pertinentes a fabricação dos produtos podendo operar máquinas e/ou equipamentos conforme instrução de trabalho;
  • Apoiar a equipe de manutenção quando necessário, cumprindo todos os procedimentos de segurança para o apoio a estas atividades;
  • Realizar inspeções, pequenos reparos, ajustes e limpeza das instalações mecânicas mediante prévio treinamento;
  • Realizar apontamentos das informações sobre segurança, qualidade, produtividade e consumo reportando ao superior imediato as não conformidades;
  • Realizar o check list de inspeção e planos de limpeza diário;
  • Participar da rotina semanal de limpeza de equipamentos críticos;
  • Participar em projetos de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala 6x2;
  • Possuir laudo médico e exames comprobatórios atualizados.

title: Head of Medical Aesthetics Sales
description:
PLEASE CAN I ASK FOR AN ENGLISH CV WHEN YOU APPLY?


*** we are NOT looking to hire you as an employee - rather to work with you as a consultant -


*** we will need you to come from the medical aesthetics industry, ideally from one of the big companies like Allergen, Galderma, Mertz, Rennova etc...


*** you will have a large network of healthcare clinics, Aesthetic GPs, Cosmetic & Plastic surgeons, Dentists (who use dermal fillers and Botox related products), and Dermatologists in Brazil - and you will be used to selling to them


** you will need to have fluency in English.


About the Company


  • My client is a $100m private investment fund that specialises in the medical aesthetics industry and has a network of warehouses globally that serve as local procurement centres which source and ship products to global customers
  • The customer tends to be small - medium size health care professionals such as cosmetic, plastic & derma surgeons as well as Aesthetics GPs.
  • In essence, my client is a B2B distributor of medical devices & medical aesthetics products like botox and derma fillers
  • They have a presence in over 13 countries and have the majority share of 15+ businesses that specialise in medical aesthetic (B2B) distribution - ecommerce (B2C) and on ground selling to clinics (B2B)


About the Need:


  • My client is looking for a consultant, or someone that they will work with on a contractual basis (you won't be an employee) who already has an existent business set up, in selling medical aesthetics (specifically dermal fillers and Botox injectables) into Health Care Practises / Beauty Salons / Clinics in Brazil.
  • They will be able to supply you with all the 3rd party sourced products (Botox and dermal fillers) and you will leverage your local network to help with the assortment, and you will use your own ground sales network to open up the Brazilian market for my client.
  • Brazil is a good market for this business, as is the wider LATAM region.
  • Maybe you own a beauty clinic, or chain of beauty clinics already in Brazil.
  • Maybe you used to work in Sales for the big global manufactures within medical aesthetics in Brazil and now you are on your own, working as a sales rep, and looking for new products to sell.
  • Maybe your run your own distribution business in Brazil and you have a huge network of beauty salons / clinics - that you already are selling too.
  • You must be fluent in English (written and verbal) to be relevant.


YOU MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE IN BRAZIL SELLING INTO BEAUTY CLINICS / AESTHETIC MEDICINE CLINICS for dermal fillers and injectables only (not prescription medicine).



Responsibilities

  • Someone who will head up the on ground wholesale sales into Brazil in partnership with the the fund - To be relevant for this, you will already either be doing this currently, or have done this very recently in your background
  • You will be selling medical aesthetics like dermal fillers, Botox, injectables directly to any kind of healthcare clinic that uses them. Therefore you MUST have previous experience in selling to small - medium size health care practises who stock similar products.
  • Previous experience in selling to beauty salons, cosmetic GPs and Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons, Aesthetics GPs is essential for success within this capacity
  • This person, or partner, or business, will own the wholesale distribution for the Brazilian market
  • You will leverage your network in Brazil, and detailed product expertise within medical aesthetics, to help determine the price for resale as well as the wider assortment of products needed within the market. Where are the gaps? What are the gaps? You will bring detail expertise to the table here

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora ADVPL Sênior
description:
Venha fazer parte da maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil como Desenvolvedor ADVPL!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a fundo a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de média e alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Utiliza frameworks já definidos para o desenvolvimento de soluções.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Lógica de Programação;
  • Banco de Dados (avançado);
  • Linguagem de programação utilizada pelo time (exemplo: ADVPL,POUI, TLPP, C#,Node.js, Python, React, outros, deve ser especialista em ADVPL);
  • Desenvolvimento orientado a objetos;
  • Fundamento em testes unitários - nível avançado;
  • Arquitetura de Software (como: cliente-servidor, web, outros) – nível intermediário;
  • Imprescindível conhecimento em desenvolvimento de APIs (Rest e/ou Soap);
  • Conhecimentos em controladores de versão (TFS, GIT);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software (Kanban, Scrum)
  • Sólidos conhecimentos nos módulos de Backoffice do Protheus (Financeiro, Contábil, Fiscal, Compras, faturamento);

title: Murex FO Trading
description:
Project Description

DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration. We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology, or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities

- Part of an embedment team, candidates will be part of Murex application support / build team performing the following responsibilities:

- Resolve daily FO issues on both functional, valuation, and pricing

- Liaise with the technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve FO related issues and necessary enhancements

- Develop FO Business requirements per given stream and according to Project needs as they come along

- Yield Curve management and validation; curve assignments; new curve creation

- Products (IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD) management and validation

- Manage day-to-day assigned project tasks to complete various FO deliverables

- Contribute and assist existing support group(s) in resolving requests or issues with P&L, Market Data, and booking issues

- Analyze, formulate, propose, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Continuous follow-up of new Market regulations/practices globally

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Ability to utilize specialized knowledge on financial derivatives and Murex software to participate in implementation and upgrade projects throughout scoping, design, build and validation phases.

- Provide high-quality support in using the Murex platform for pricing and structuring of complex financial products within trading domain (e.g. FX derivatives, interest rates derivatives, Fixed Income etc.).

- Develop test cases to troubleshoot the system, document defective use cases for fixes by developers.


Skills Description

- Strong analytical, pricing, and Front Office skills

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

- Strong presentation skills

- Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally

- Strong experience in supporting FO users and resolving their daily issues


Must:

- 2+ years experience on Murex with FO functionalities/module

- 1+ years of experience in financial markets/IT business analysis

- Must have a strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner, and a self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

description:

Keeta is an independent brand of Meituan, the world's largest tech-driven retail company. We focus on food and consumer product delivery services in international markets with the mission: "We help people eat better, live better".

5. English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.


The following are preferred:

1. Experience in the food delivery industry and the local-based service industry is preferred.

2. Proficient in using SQL or other data analysis tools.

3. Experience in merchant operations/strategy operations/product operations preferred.


What Make This Role Exciting:

1. A startup team with plenty of opportunities to participate in core projects for rapid growth.

2. Experiencing different countries, languages, and cultures.

In this role you will:

  • Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;
  • Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;
  • In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;
  • Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;
  • Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

And much better if you stand out for:

  • Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;
  • Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;
  • Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;
  • Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

description:
Sênior Data Governance


Modalidade: Híbrida - 3x na semana em SP

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Governança de Dados Sênior que seja apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em um ativo estratégico. Você terá a chance de fazer a diferença em nossa empresa, atuando como o(a) grande evangelista da governança de dados e qualidade de dados para as áreas de negócio e técnica. Sua missão é ir além da técnica: você irá empreender, mostrar o valor da qualidade de dados e mensurar o impacto de cada iniciativa. Você será responsável por liderar iniciativas de governança, qualidade e maturidade de dados, com a autonomia para planejar, implementar e prestar suporte técnico para a área de Analistas, Engenharia e Cientistas de Dados.

Se você tem uma mentalidade de produto e adora um bom desafio, esta vaga é para você!

Atuar no planejamento e execução das ações de Governança de Dados.

Liderar e Mensurar o Programa de Qualidade de Dados e Metadados: Capacidade de traduzir métricas e resultados de qualidade de dados em dashboards claros, intuitivos e acionáveis para diferentes públicos, incluindo a alta gestão. Isso inclui a criação de KPIs, dashboards e relatórios de acompanhamento.

Evoluir o Produto: Não apenas use, mas ajude a evoluir nosso motor de qualidade para que ele possa ir além da checagem técnica e também garanta a qualidade de negócio. Você será a voz do cliente interno, definindo e priorizando melhorias.

Promover a Maturidade de Dados: Crie e implemente padrões, políticas e processos que elevem a maturidade de toda a nossa governança de dados e que suportem a nossa estratégia de dados de longo prazo.

Gerenciar e Disseminar: Seja o(a) guardião(a) do nosso catálogo e glossário de dados. Garanta que eles sejam completos, atualizados e que a empresa "fale a mesma língua" quando o assunto é dado. Você será responsável por definir a metodologia de catalogação e garantir a adoção por todas as áreas.

Atuar como Especialista: Dar suporte técnico a analistas, engenheiros e cientistas de dados, sendo o ponto focal para resolver problemas de qualidade e inconsistências, bem como problemas nas ferramentas.

title: Risk & Audit Expert Talent
description:
Risk & Audit Expert Talent at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo - Brazil, hybrid, fulltime


people at the heart of everything we do

Working at Randstad is unlike working at any organization. Because at Randstad we put people at the heart of everything we do. This goes for our clients, our talent, our employees and society. We combine our passion for people with the power of today’s technologies. This helps us support people and organizations in realizing their true potential. We call this partner for talent..

Learn more about our mission, history and values on our website:


BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.


The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.


Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.


how you will contribute

You are part of the Business Risk & Audit Function (BR&AF) that covers all business operations related to Clients, Talents and our (shared) Back-, Mid- and Front offices, as well as our Accounting & Reporting and other specialist functions like HR.


With your risk & audit experience and expertise you enhance Randstad's in-control situation together with other team members. This by preparing and performing: risk assessments; internal control assessments; audits; and reviews, and compile reports on these activities that make an impact on management.


  • you provide management combined assurance, utilizing insights from enterprise risk management, internal control as well as internal audits that you lead and/or execute. Therewith you create momentum within the company to strengthen the risk-control position for our operational, shared services and accounting processes.
  • you maintain contact with local and international management, global and local process owners and collaborate closely with other involved stakeholders like other impacted functions within the group.
  • you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as: our Client delivery and Talent operations specialists; and HR, Tax, Accounting & Reporting and Planning & Control specialists.
  • you take ownership for the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.
  • you are willing to travel. As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.


what you will be doing

As an independent and objective risk & audit expert, you are going to:

  • participate and take the lead in risk assessments and audit planning and scoping, including researching relevant business objectives, policies, regulations.
  • prepare and execute audits by evaluating and analyzing the design and operating effectiveness of controls in mitigating identified risks.
  • execute audits and reviews for operational processes and controls, in areas such as: client delivery and Talent intake, as well as shared services operations and specialist functions like HR management, marketing & communication, finance, accounting & reporting, planning & control, non-financial reporting.
  • participate and lead audit interviews, be accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management, based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a recourse for colleagues with less expertise.


who will you work with

  • Business operations managers both working with our Clients and Talents, as well as shared services center managers and functional specialists in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Business operations and shared services process owners and control owners in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Tax and Legal counterparts (including legal compliance leads) both at corporate level as well as in our operating companies
  • MD BR&AF, other BR&AF leaders, team members and business partners
  • External co-source partners


what you will bring

Your risk & audit skills are well developed, as a critical challenger to process owners and business managers you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest and business acumen for Client delivery and Talent related operational processes as well as shared services organizations, how they serve internal customers and optimize their operations. You have a broad interest in specialist functions that support the overall governance of Randstad's international presence.

As an Internal Audit Expert you:

  • have minimum 8 years of relevant experience
  • have minimum master degree in business or economics and related accreditation (e.g. CPA/CA/CIA/ACCA)
  • have level BEC B1/B2 or higher Business English, preferably combined with proficiency in one of the following languages: Dutch, Spanish, French, Italian and /or German
  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo
  • have experience with excel in risk & audit methodologies & tools and internal control theories
  • have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job learning & development
  • have a proven track record in control design & implementation, risk based auditing and reporting.
  • are experienced in performing integrated audits working with changing teams
  • are specialized depth and breadth of expertise in business process risk analysis
  • have experience with data driven analysis


your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances
  • collaborates, reaches out, you excel in organizational sensitivity: maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization


what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad here .


If you recognize yourself in the profile above, we invite you to apply for this role. For more information you can reach out to our recruitment business partner:


The recruitment procedure consists of a screening and at least two interviews. Later in the process, an (online) assessment and a job offer conversation take place.

To apply, please submit your resume (CV) and a cover letter.

title: Volunteer Doctor, South Africa
description:
Are you passionate about using your knowledge and skills to help others? Answer your calling, and take your leave of purpose.


The Tshemba Foundation is appealing to international doctors to address a critical health care gap in rural South Africa’s north eastern provinces where doctor shortages are posing substantial challenges to adequate health care.


You will experience and learn from a stimulating and challenging working environment, treat conditions and cases not usually seen in urban areas and help leave a legacy of improved quality of care by sharing knowledge and skills with local staff who are eager for support.


Tshemba offers its volunteers free, safe and secure accommodation at its Volunteer Lodge, situated in Moditlo Private Game Reserve. The Lodge serves as a welcome off-duty refuge where like-minded healthcare providers relax after an intense day of work. Here they exchange ideas, create healthcare solutions for daily challenges faced and connect with peers from all over the world, all the while taking in the magnificent natural surroundings.


In your role as a volunteer doctor you can offer:

  • direct or indirect patient care in various departments of a public hospital and/or surrounding clinics
  • postgraduate support to medical staff in training
  • skills development and/or formal teaching for local staff
  • administrative or management support, including clinical and quality improvement projects
  • develop health interventions and protocols alongside local staff


Our clinical team will work with you to develop a personalized volunteer schedule that combines your skills and experience with the needs of various hospital departments and clinics in the area.


Length of placement:

  • Currently, volunteer placement lengths are flexible based on your area of expertise. We recommend a minimum of 8 weeks for generalist international volunteers and can negotiate shorter stays for specialists. We will work with you to determine where you will be placed and how long your stay will be to have maximum impact.


Requirements:

  • A current license in good standing from your medical regulatory body
  • Registration with ECFMG and the Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) which our team will assist you to apply for. Current ECFMG certification will expedite the process.
  • We welcome interest from ALL REGISTERED PHYSICIANS however, the greatest current need are for Radiologists, Family physicians, Geriatricians, Neurologists, Dermatologists, Internists, Psychiatrists, Paediatricians, Gastroenterologists, Ophthalmologists and General Surgeons.


Physicians who have volunteered with Tshemba tell us that they have been re-energized and transformed by the experience, and their passion for medicine reignited.


Please reach out if you have any questions and to discuss volunteering your time.

Na Valentino, atuamos como uma Comunidade e Empresa Únicas. Agimos com integridade e respeito tanto com o nosso Planeta quanto com as Pessoas. Nosso objetivo é criar EMOÇÃO e DESEJO no cliente, pois nosso futuro depende da nossa imaginação e da paixão pelo trabalho e pela vida: cada ação que você realiza o aproxima dos seus sonhos.


QUEM ESTAMOS PROCURANDO

Estagiário Administrativo de Loja – Loja Valentino Shopping Iguatemi

Buscamos um talento em início de carreira que deseje aprender e se desenvolver em um ambiente dinâmico e sofisticado. O estagiário administrativo terá papel essencial no suporte às rotinas operacionais da loja, contribuindo para a excelência nos processos internos e na organização do estoque.

title: Analista de Dados Sênior
description:
Potência Total em Soluções Financeiras: Somos uma empresa completa que impulsiona o ecossistema de combustíveis, oferecendo soluções que incluem Conta Digital PF, Conta Digital PJ, Corretora de Seguros, Cartão Benefícios, Cartão de Crédito, Clube de Vantagens, Folha de Pagamento, Cobrança, Asset, FIDC, e muito mais. Nossa Missão: Ser a principal fonte de soluções financeiras eficientes e aceleradas para postos de combustível, refinarias, distribuidoras, transportadoras de combustível, além de apoiar seus colaboradores e clientes. Acelere com a Gente: Junte-se a nós para transformar o cenário financeiro do mundo dos combustíveis, aproveitando cada oportunidade de crescimento e inovação!


Responsabilidades

  • Extração e Transformação de Dados (ETL/ELT): Apoiar na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados, garantindo a ingestão, transformação e carregamento de dados de diversas fontes para o Data Lake.
  • Modelagem e Organização de Dados: Colaborar na definição e implementação de modelos de dados eficiente, visando otimizar o armazenamento e a consulta.
  • Qualidade e Governança de Dados: Auxiliar na implementação de rotinas de validação e monitoramento da qualidade dos dados, contribuindo para a governança e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Criação de Dashboards e Relatórios: Desenvolver e manter painéis de dados e relatórios para diversas áreas de negócio, utilizando as informações centralizadas para gerar insights e apoiar a tomada de decisão.
  • Suporte à Análise de Dados: Prestar apoio à equipe na realização de análises exploratórias de dados, identificando tendências e padrões relevantes para o negócio.
  • Colaboração Interáreas: Atuar em parceria com equipes de negócio, tecnologia, produto e outras, garantindo o alinhamento na utilização dos dados do Data Lake e na entrega de valor.
  • Documentação e Melhoria Contínua: Participar da documentação de processos e estruturas de dados, e contribuir para a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria nas ferramentas e metodologias de dados.


Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com Python e SQL: Capacidade de manipular, consultar e processar dados eficientemente.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de Data Lake e Data Warehouses: Experiência em modelagem de dados e construção de pipelines de dados e processos de ETL/ELT.
  • Ferramentas de Visualização de Dados: Domínio em Power BI, incluindo Power Query, linguagem M e DAX. Experiência com outras ferramentas como Tableau e Looker Studio é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de Elaborar Consultas Complexas e Criar Visualizações Impactantes: Habilidade para produzir insights claros e valiosos a partir dos dados.
  • Ferramentas de ETL: Experiência com ferramentas da Microsoft e outras plataformas de ETL.
  • Plataformas em Nuvem: Familiaridade com Microsoft Azure ou plataformas similares para gestão de dados.
  • Bancos de Dados Relacionais: Experiência com SQL Server, Oracle, entre outros, incluindo elaboração de consultas complexas.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com Ferramentas de Nuvem: Conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) e serviços relacionados a Data Lake (S3, ADLS, GCS, Athena, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas de ETL/ELT: Experiência com ferramentas como Apache Airflow, DBT, Stitch, Fivetran ou similares.
  • Certificações: Certificações em plataformas de dados ou nuvem (AWS Certified Data Analytics, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Modelo presencial de segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48 na região da Henrique Schaumann, próximo ao metrô Oscar Freire.

title: Consultor Sênior TAX Due Diligence - Impostos Diretos
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars


Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.


Sobre Nós


Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

title: User Research Lead
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a User Research Lead who is committed and passionate about understanding people behaviour, taste and also about gaming! This role will be responsible for organizing, and executing researches with different methodologies aiming to provide actionable reports in order to improve Garena gaming portfolio.


Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!



Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.



Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and synthesize player data to uncover insights on preferences, behaviors, and pain points.
  • Plan and execute end-to-end research studies using surveys, focus groups, interviews, playtests, and other methods.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize research needs and align with project goals.
  • Champion a player-first mindset across the organization by advocating for evidence-based decision-making.
  • Translate research findings into actionable recommendations for game design, product, and publishing teams.
  • Lead and mentor a team of user researchers, fostering their growth and ensuring high-quality output.
  • Ensure consistent, reliable research practices that reflect the voice of players
  • Stay current on research methodologies and gaming trends to continuously elevate research impact.


Main job requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree completed;
  • 8+ years of experience in user research, including 2–3 years in a leadership or managerial capacity. Hands-on experience with both qualitative and quantitative research techniques;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken;
  • Skilled in designing and conducting surveys, FGDs, interviews, and usability studies.
  • Strong ability to communicate insights clearly and persuasively to non-research audiences.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple projects and collaborating across departments.
  • Passion for games or a strong understanding of gaming culture and player motivations.
  • Excellent project management and organization skills and familiarity with Agile methodology.
  • Adherence to all core values.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the gaming or entertainment industry.
  • Proficiency with research tools like Qualtrics, SPSS, Dovetail, or similar.
  • Be familiarized with ChatGPT and Gemini and open to develop AI skills

title: Data Integration Specialist
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description

The Data Integration Specialist designs and implements the technical infrastructure needed to consolidate the school’s data into a centralized repository. This role develops and maintains automated data pipelines, integrates multiple systems, and ensures data is structured for reporting. The specialist also supports the creation of dashboards and visualizations in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom web applications, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate data from multiple school systems and spreadsheets.Automated data pipelines (APIs, CSV, ETL processes, cloud-based tools) reducing manual work and improving accuracy.
  • Build and manage automated ETL processes (APIs, SQL, Python scripts, CSV workflows).
  • Use Microsoft cloud tools (e.g., Data Factory, Power Automate) to streamline and automate workflows.Dashboards and reports delivered in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom-built web applications.
  • Maintain and enhance data-oriented web applications based on front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React) and backend development (e.g., Python or .NET).
  • Document data structures, pipelines, and integration standards to ensure long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate with the Systems & Data Admin to validate that technical outputs meet business needs.
  • Ensure solutions are cost-effective and appropriate for a K12 international school context.


Qualifications


Candidates should bring most or all of the following:

  • Solid experience in a similar role.
  • Experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, or similar).
  • Ability to design data models and schemas for reporting.Strong technical skills in data integration (APIs, SQL, CSV, ETL).
  • Proficiency with visualization tools (Looker Studio, Power BI).Proficiency with Python for data manipulation and system integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud automation tools (Microsoft Data Factory, Power Automate).
  • Ability to support and maintain custom dashboards and webapps (Azure, Python, Angular, Bootstrap).Use of Git/version control and documentation for maintainability.
  • Apply data quality assurance practices: cleaning, validating, monitoring pipelines.
  • Shows humility and confidence.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist  to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital


You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency. Your focus: deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.


Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know who  to contact, how , and when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years  of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of SQL , Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.

Nice to have:

  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).

    • What we offer

    Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

    But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

    • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
    • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
    • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
    • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
    • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

description:
Location: Remote South America (Central Time Zone - USA. 8am - 5pm)

NOTE: Must speak excellent English.


We’re a high-growth recruiting firm trusted by mid-market and venture-backed companies to deliver top-tier talent in Technology, Product Management, and Executive Search. Our model spans contract, contract-to-hire, and direct hire placements, offering clients flexibility, speed, and culture-aligned hiring solutions.


Our sales team is the tip of the spear. We're looking for a Senior Sales Development Representative to help us accelerate growth by setting qualified meetings with decision-makers at fast-moving companies.


The Role


As a Senior SDR, you’ll be responsible for creating high-quality opportunities for our Managing Director through proactive outbound outreach across multiple channels. Your mission: generate meaningful conversations with hiring leaders at mid-market companies (100–5,000 employees) across the U.S.


This role is high-volume, phone-led, and metrics-driven—best suited for someone who thrives in a high-energy environment and knows how to position consulting services in a competitive market.


What You'll Do

  • Own the top of the funnel for all outbound activity across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Research and segment leads using ZoomInfo, Crelate, and LinkedIn Premium
  • Execute 100 –120+ cold calls/day, plus daily targeted emails and LinkedIn messaging
  • Book qualified meetings with decision-makers (typically VPs, Directors, and Founders)
  • Track activity and pipeline through SourceWhale and internal CRM systems
  • Partner closely with the Managing Director to ensure meeting quality and ICP alignment
  • Iterate and improve outreach campaigns based on performance metrics and conversion data


What We're Looking For

  • 2–5+ years of SDR experience in a B2B consulting or staffing/recruiting environment
  • Proven success generating meetings with mid-market U.S. clients
  • Mastery of cold calling and sales engagement tools (SourceWhale, ZoomInfo, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of professional services, especially in technology, product, or executive search
  • Confident, curious, and motivated by the challenge of breaking into new accounts
  • Comfortable with high daily activity targets and KPI-driven accountability
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills


What You’ll Get

  • Base salary + bonuses with uncapped earning potential
  • Daily mentorship from a Managing Director with deep industry experience
  • Flexible, remote-first work culture with outcome-driven autonomy
  • Access to best-in-class tools to power your outreach and workflow
  • Opportunity to grow into a full-cycle sales or account management role

title: Senior Strategy Research Associate
description:
About Keeta


Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!



Know more: Keeta Website


About the Job


Senior Strategy Research Associate


Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP


Job Responsibilities：


1. Study the business segments, geographical layout, financial strength, and strategic play of the world's leading food delivery players, form a clear judgment on the global food delivery industry landscape and competitive situation, and propose effective development strategies and competitive strategies based on this judgment to support Keeta management's major decisions on resource allocation, organizational structure, capital operation, etc.


2. Participate in desk research, field research, and strategy formulation for Keeta's expansion into new countries, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation path of the company's strategic expansion into new regions, and combine facts and analysis to provide objective judgments on the industry, competition, and operational difficulties in specific countries to assist Keeta management in making decisions;


3. Understand the catering and food delivery industries, gain insight into the laws of industry development, keep close track of new opportunities and new models in related areas such as instant retail and catering SaaS, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation paths of new strategic directions to assist Keeta management in making decisions and assist in business implementation. Job Responsibilities:


4. Analyze the restaurant and food delivery industries, identify industry trends, and monitor emerging opportunities in related sectors such as quick commerce and restaurant SaaS. Explore and evaluate the feasibility of new strategic directions to support management in decision-making and business implementation.


Job Requirements：

  • Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in business-related majors such as business administration, finance, accounting, and economics;
  • At least three years of relevant experience in internet strategy analysis, strategic consulting, investment, and investment banking, with research experience in the catering, retail, and food delivery industries preferred;

Highlights：


- Contribute to the foundational growth of the Brazil business from inception.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we help people be their best in the moments that matter. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. Our work is very meaningful, impactful, and cutting edge and we invite you to explore it. We are the Best!


Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of professional mobile communications systems with an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. The group's main business is the implementation of mission critical digital mobile communication systems for Government & Public Safety Communications customers.


Join to the team providing Solution Architecture for Unified Communications customers for EMEA/APAC/LATAM regions.


Job Description

Join a dynamic and innovative team at the forefront of mission-critical communications. We are responsible for delivering advanced Push-to-Talk (PTT) solutions over broadband with seamless interoperability to Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems. As a Network and Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining the core infrastructure that powers our services.

The ideal candidate is a skilled and proactive individual with a strong background in IP networking, a deep understanding of cloud-native technologies, and an interest in cybersecurity. In addition to core engineering duties, you will take ownership of hardware ordering and security vulnerability management, making this a pivotal role within the team.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain robust IP network infrastructure, including switches and firewalls.
  • Manage and support virtualization and containerized environments, with a focus on cloud-native platforms like OpenShift and Podman.
  • Lead the hardware ordering process for the team, utilizing the Motorola CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) system.
  • Monitor and manage security-related issues, including vulnerability management for customer-facing solutions.
  • Ensure the reliable and secure interoperability between broadband PTT solutions and Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and contribute to solution architecture.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering
  • In-depth knowledge of IP networking principles and practical experience with switches and firewalls.
  • Demonstrated experience with virtualization technologies and container platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies, such as OpenShift or Podman.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to system maintenance and security.


Preferred Skills & Qualifications (A Plus)

Certifications:

  • CompTIA Network+, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Security+
  • CCNA or CCNP
  • Juniper, FortiGate, or Extreme Networks certifications


Engineering Expertise:

  • Experience with datacenter engineering, including server connectivity (Ethernet vs. fiber) and adapters.
  • A strong interest or background in cybersecurity.


Relevant Experience:

  • Previous experience with Push-to-Talk (PTT) over broadband or Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware ordering processes and CPQ systems.

title: Quality Assurance Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Job Summary:

Highridge Medical creates the world’s most innovative spinal solutions across the spectrum from Motion Preservation to MIS to Bone Healing to Core Spine. Working at Highridge Medical is not just work. Life at Highridge Medical is purpose driven. Every day, you have the privilege of using your talents to demonstrate Confidence in your work and restore Confidence for our patients. Confidence that moves.


The Regulatory and Quality Affairs Manager will oversee quality assurance and regulatory compliance for Highridge Medical’s operation in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring local alignment with global regulations and standards and for ensuring corporate alignment with Brazilian regulations and standards. This role will collaborate with cross-functional teams locally and globally to maintain product quality, manage regulatory submissions, and support market access.


Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure Compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements per ANVISA standards for product registration, licensing, and post-market Surveillance.
  • Prepare, submit, and manage regulatory dossiers for product approvals, renewals, and significant changes in Brazil.
  • Act as primary point of contact for Latin American distributors who are building dossiers to submit for approvals, renewals, and significant changes in their markets.
  • Monitor changes in Brazilian and Latin American regulations and advise on their impact to company operations.
  • Liase with ANVISA and other regulatory bodies as the primary point of contact, and Technical Responsible person, in Brazil.
  • Work with US based team members to develop global procedures that appropriately capture Brazilian requirements.
  • Advise local and corporate leadership on regulatory and quality strategies for market expansion in Brazil and other Latin American markets.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.


Quality Assurance:

  • Maintain and improve the local Quality Management System in accordance with Brazilian GMP and international standards.
  • Partner with corporate quality and regulatory teams to ensure global alignment of policies and procedures.
  • Conduct internal and external audits to ensure compliance with Quality Standards.
  • Manage Non-Conformances (NCs) and Corrective Action/Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to resolve quality issues for the Brazilian site.
  • Support global NCs and CAPAs to resolve quality issues which impact Brazil and Latin American markets.
  • Ensure proper documentation and record keeping for quality and regulatory processes both within the Brazilian site and at any 3rd party logistics providers in Brazil.
  • Implement Vigilance systems to track product performance on the Brazilian Market.
  • Organize and run Brazilian Management Review meetings.
  • Provide training to local staff on regulatory requirements and quality standards.
  • Host ANVISA for any audits that may need to take place at the Brazilian site.


Expected Areas of Competence (i.e., knowledge, skills, and abilities)

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal); Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, international teams, company leadership, distributors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Working knowledge of global regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Ability to lead a team, influence others, and handle increasing levels of responsibility.
  • Understands the overall business environment, the orthopedic industry, and the marketplace. Direct experience with spinal implant companies is a plus.
  • Ability to identify and assess business risks to develop Regulatory strategy
  • Ability to manage/supervise employees and consultants.
  • Excellent project management and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong computer skills.

Education/Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (e.g. life sciences, engineering, pharmacy, or related discipline).
  • Advanced degree preferred
  • 6-8 years of experience required in a Regulatory and Quality Affairs capacity.
  • Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) preferred
  • Experience in the areas implantable medical device regulatory and quality affairs is strongly preferred.
  • A combination of education and experience may be considered

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15%

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Acompanhamento, atualização, controle e análise dos principais indicadores do shopping como: NOI, Receitas e custos, L.S., Tx Ocupação, SSS, SSR, SAS;
  • Realização de orçamento anual, planejamento estratégico/comercial, acompanhamento de resultado YTD e Forecast;
  • Apresentação PPT para Diretoria (RMR) e Comitês (Inadimplência, comercial, jurídico);
  • Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudança de locatários, discussões contratuais).


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Superior Completo em administração, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em negociação comercial e gestão de equipes;
  • Pacote Office avançado, especialmente Excel;

title: Logistics Manager (Ecommerce Last Mile ）
description:
Job Responsibilities


  • Last Mile Operations Management: Oversee last mile logistics, ensuring timely and cost-efficient parcel distribution through partner carriers. Monitor daily operations, investigate anomalies, and implement corrective actions to maintain service excellence.
  • Performance Management: Define and track KPIs such as on-time delivery, delivery success rate, and transit times. Develop dashboards and reports to provide data-driven insights to internal stakeholders and senior management.
  • Supplier Coordination: Manage relationships with last mile carriers, ensuring service levels meet company standards. Conduct regular meetings, align volume forecasts, and monitor SLAs to maintain high performance.
  • Operational Standardization: Establish and document best practices for last mile logistics. Define roles, responsibilities, and performance management models to ensure consistency across operations.
  • Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements in delivery operations. Benchmark industry best practices and develop initiatives to enhance efficiency, capacity, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Incident Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Lead proactive issue resolution, ensuring smooth communication between teams and timely escalation of critical cases. Implement feedback loops to drive continuous operational improvements.
  • Strategic Network Planning: Support the development of last mile network strategies, aligning logistics infrastructure with business growth plans and cost optimization goals.


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in last mile logistics operations, preferably in e-commerce and/or express logistics.
  • Operational Expertise: Strong understanding of last mile logistics, carrier coordination, and performance management.
  • Experience with Next-Day and Second-Day Delivery: Knowledge of express delivery models and their operational challenges.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to analyze KPIs, identify risks, and drive process improvements through data insights.
  • Hands-on Approach: Willingness to visit field operations, engage with carriers, and ensure seamless execution.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Quick analytical thinking to address operational challenges and implement preventive measures.
  • Project Management: Experience in leading and executing logistics projects, working cross-functionally to achieve business goals.
  • Mandatory fluency in Portuguese and English. Spanish and Mandarin are a plus.

title: Audio Producer
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Audio Producer with a strong background in sound design and audio production workflows. This role involves leadership in audio pipeline development, cross-functional collaboration, and managing external partnerships to deliver exceptional audio experiences. This role will provide hands-on support in sound design tasks and operational processes , ensuring smooth workflows for voice-over and sound deliveries.


Please, make sure to share in your CV or Linkedin, the link of your portfolio/IMDB/Demo reel.


Exclusivity contract required.

  • Design detailed music, sound effects, and voice-over production schedules, ensuring alignment with multidisciplinary planning and vendor timelines;
  • Estimate budgets based on project scope, anticipating potential changes and risks;

  • Fluent in Portuguese written and spoken;

  • Passion for games or a strong understanding of gaming culture and player motivations;
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
Location: São Paulo, Brazil | Reports to: VP & GM, Americas


Why Join Us

GigaDevice Semiconductor is one of the world’s fastest-growing semiconductor companies and a global leader in SPI NOR Flash and a top 10 global provider of 32-bit MCUs. With a rapidly expanding portfolio that now includes NOR Flash, ARM and RISC-V based MCUs, sensors, PMUs, and niche DRAM, we serve high-growth markets including automotive, industrial, IoT, consumer electronics, and computing.


In Brazil, we are committed to building a stronger presence and winning share in a highly dynamic and competitive market. As a Field Application Engineer (FAE) based in Brazil, you will be responsible for providing technical support to customers designing with GigaDevice’s non-volatile memories, microcontrollers, power devices, and sensors. You will work closely with the sales and marketing team to drive technical discussions, convert design-ins into design-wins, and strengthen our position in the region. This role is critical not only in supporting current products but also in shaping future product development by working with customers, engineering, and technical marketing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to customers both on-site and virtually.
  • Engage with customers to thoroughly understand their design requirements, identify additional projects, and capture new business opportunities across product lines.
  • Serve as the primary technical driver for design-in to design-win conversion, providing pre- and post-sales technical support.
  • Deliver technical training to customers, partners, and distributors
  • Understand the product landscape in the field and gather competitive and market intelligence
  • Develop application notes and contribute to product qualification activities .
  • Maintain strong technical expertise, particularly in embedded systems and MCU products
  • Travel within Brazil (and occasionally to other Latin American markets) to ensure GigaDevice maintains a strong presence.


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in the electronics industry , with a focus on Arm Cortex-M based microcontroller products ; familiarity with RISC-V ISA is a plus.
  • Strong ability to read, understand, and develop C/C++ code for Arm microcontrollers.
  • Knowledge of operating systems such as FreeRTOS .
  • Proficiency with IDE tools including Keil uVision v5 and IAR Embedded Workbench.
  • Ability to read electronic design schematics , use measurement instruments, and familiarity with EDA tools.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Motor Control solutions .
  • Independent, analytical, and self-motivated with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to travel regionally to support customers.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English ; Spanish a plus.
  • High integrity, proactive, results-driven, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical field. Master’s degree preferred; other technical or business degrees considered with relevant experience.

title: Senior Incubation Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE POSITION:


This role focuses on supporting the incubation process for new business opportunities, working with internal teams and entrepreneurs to develop promising ideas from conception to implementation. You will be at the heart of innovation initiatives, helping to transform concepts into viable business ventures through structured adjustment processes and collaborative problem-solving.


Responsabilities:

1. Assist in executing incubation strategies to identify and nurture high-potential business opportunities.

2. Conduct basic market research and data collection to support viability assessments and opportunity evaluations.

3. Participate in the incubation process, including assisting with ideation, prototyping, and testing activities.

4. Work with team leaders and stakeholders to support resource mobilization and maintain alignment with project objectives.

5. Follow assigned tasks and collaborate effectively within the incubation team to ensure progress in daily operations.

6. Monitor key metrics, report updates on progress, and maintain documentation for incubation projects.

7. Support entrepreneurs or project teams by providing operational assistance and implementing action plans under guidance.

8. Communicate challenges, updates, and suggestions to team leaders or supervisors on a regular basis.


Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business, e-commerce, or a related field. Previous experience in business operations, market research, or startup-related work is preferred but not mandatory.

2. Ability to effectively execute assigned tasks, adapt in dynamic environments, and demonstrate strong collaboration skills.

3. Basic analytical and problem-solving abilities, with openness to learning and applying creative solutions.

4. Familiarity with the Brazilian market, local e-commerce trends, and willingness to travel occasionally to visit merchants.

5. Fluency or advanced proficiency in English is mandatory


At Shein, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: SDR - Sales Development Representative

Avalia a adequação dos leads, agenda reuniões entre prospects qualificados e os representantes de vendas, e mantém dados precisos no CRM. Além disso, colabora com a equipe de vendas, fornece feedback para aprimorar processos e trabalha para atingir metas de prospecção estabelecidas, garantindo uma transição eficiente de leads qualificados para a equipe de vendas.


Principais atividades:


  • Realizar pesquisas para identificar empresas e contatos que podem se beneficiar dos produtos ou serviços oferecidos. Utilizar métodos como cold calling, e-mails e redes sociais para entrar em contato com prospects e qualificar leads.
  • Avaliar a adequação dos leads com base em critérios predefinidos, como orçamento, responsável pela decisão de fechamento, necessidade, prazo previsto para o fechamento e perfil da empresa. Estabelecer um primeiro contato para entender as necessidades do prospect e determinar seu potencial como cliente.

  • Registrar todas as interações com os leads no sistema de CRM (Customer Relationship Management), mantendo informações atualizadas e precisas. Monitorar o progresso dos leads e garantir que todos os detalhes importantes sejam documentados e seguidos.
  • Passar leads qualificados para a equipe de vendas, garantindo uma transição suave e completa de informações. Colaborar com a equipe de vendas para fornecer feedback sobre a qualidade dos leads e sugestões para melhorar o processo de prospecção.
  • Trabalhar para atingir metas de prospecção e qualificação estabelecidas pela equipe ou pela empresa. Monitorar e reportar o desempenho das atividades de prospecção, analisando dados para melhorar a eficácia das estratégias.
  • Participar de treinamentos e workshops para melhorar técnicas de prospecção e habilidades de comunicação. Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos, serviços e tendências do setor para melhor abordar e engajar os prospects.

title: Gerente de SecOps
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Gerente de SecOps



Resumo:

O Gerente de SecOps é responsável pela estratégia e entrega do dia a dia de Security Operations através da companhia, incluindo SOC (Security Operations Center), Gestão de Vulnerabilidades, Pentesting e Gestão de Identidades. Esta posição, com reporte ao Diretor de Cyber Security, desempenhará um papel fundamental no fortalecimento da postura de segurança da empresa, liderando uma equipe de profissionais de segurança e garantindo que o ambiente seja continuamente monitorado e protegido.



O que você irá fazer:

  • Estratégia de SecOps: liderar a estratégia de Security Operations do ponto de vista de pessoas, processos e ferramentas, desenhando modelos de operação técnica e documentações, gerenciando ferramentas de segurança e KPIs de processos, orçamento e riscos com recursos internos e externos.
  • Liderança do SOC: liderar e supervisionar as operações 24/7 do SOC, incluindo monitoramento, detecção, resposta a incidentes e inteligência de ameaças.
  • Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: liderar o programa de gestão de vulnerabilidades da empresa, garantindo a identificação, relatório, priorização e remediação de riscos de forma eficaz para ativos de infraestrutura e código seguro.
  • Pentesting: liderar atividades e exercícios de pentest/red team internos e externos com aplicações de negócios e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de Identidade e Acesso: liderar o programa de IAM incluindo governança, provisionamento, gerenciamento de acesso privilegiado e controles de acesso baseados em funções.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: gerenciar, orientar e desenvolver uma equipe de coordenadores, engenheiros e analistas de segurança.




O que buscamos?

  • Sólida experiência em operações de cibersegurança e em funções de gestão ou liderança.
  • Excelente conhecimento e experiência prática com implementação, implantação e operações de ferramentas de segurança, incluindo SIEM/SOAR (por exemplo, Sentinel, Chronicle, Splunk), EDR/XDR (Crowdstrike, Defender, SentinelOne, etc.), scan de vulnerabilidades (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, etc.), SAST/DAST/SCA (Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk), frameworks de pentesting e red team (Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Caldera, etc.) e IAM (Azure AD, Okta, CyberArk, etc.).
  • Sólida compreensão de segurança em nuvem (Azure, GCP, AWS).
  • Ótimo conhecimento de frameworks de segurança (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, etc.).
  • Ótimas habilidades analíticas e de relatórios para apoiar a entrega de KPIs.
  • Experiência em gerenciar múltiplos fornecedores e entrega de serviços globais.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão.
  • Forte conhecimento prático das ferramentas do Office.
  • Fluente em inglês.



Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:




  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível

  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
